name: recover intact records from a damaged SQLite file
definition: Read the surviving portion of the SQLite file (via page parsing or partial recovery techniques) to extract as many original rows as possible.
failure_mode: Recovery yields too few valid rows or corrupt values that fail matching.

name: regression-check a running server against SSTI and code-execution payloads while preserving the framework identity/version
definition: Run the framework's dev server and confirm it still identifies as the expected framework/version while user input is treated safely across multiple payload classes.
failure_mode: Mitigation breaks server header/version checks or does not actually neutralize payloads
